ambiguous_OHLC: No execution outcome inferred; stop/target same-bar ordering UNKNOWN. Active contract conservatively invalidates a crossed stop without reporting a loss/fill/PnL.

exit_contract.cancellation: Invalidation, expired review validity, source block, missing data, no-fill/missed entry
exit_contract.structural_stop: Preobservable level plus separately declared ATR and execution buffers
exit_contract.targets: Declared zones, never favorable touch-based fills
exit_contract.time_exit: At predeclared 8h/24h/72h/5d horizon when supported; future LT-B/LT-C integration

expiry_boundary: expires_ms <= next_review_ms is EXPIRED, including equality
implemented_positive_state_producer: Caller-supplied OFFLINE_CONTRACT candidate only; automated S1 compiler returns None until LT-B
new_decision_trigger: Explicit completed 4H or 1D close, never intrabar/1H/tick/BBO

state_rules.ACCOUNT_UNKNOWN: No verified capital/margin information; account API not invoked
state_rules.ENTRY_ZONE_ACTIVE: Completed decision close in region; REVIEW_ONLY; never fill/order authority
state_rules.EXPIRED: TTL elapsed or validity/review deadline cannot cover next scheduled review
state_rules.INVALIDATED: Completed decision bar crosses buffered structural invalidation
state_rules.MISSED_OR_NO_CHASE: Closed price deteriorated beyond entry region; no fill inferred
state_rules.NO_SETUP: Valid completed input with no evaluated setup; never synthesize a candidate
state_rules.READY_FOR_REVIEW: Causal completed-bar contract candidate awaiting region; validity covers next scheduled check
state_rules.SOURCE_BLOCKED: Source authorization, source quality or causal identity blocked
state_rules.VETO: Explicit risk/account veto; no position management inferred
state_rules.WATCH: Informational only; legacy WATCH/ARMED/ENTRY_ELIGIBLE maps to historical WATCH without activation
